positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead for the Reservations team - our team builds the post-booking experience for guests, and the reservation management surfaces for hosts. 

Notable public launches I’ve worked on: 
- Redesigned Host Reservations (2026)
- Redesigned Host App & Airbnb Services (2025)
- Guest Group Travel (2024)
- Host Pricing Tools (2023)
- Guest Trips Tab & Arrival Guide (2022)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Guest Experience - Traveling (2021 - 2022)
Building the on-trip guest experience (arrival/check-in, reservation details and management, on-trip planning, check-out)

Growth - SEO (2019-2021)
Lead frontend engineer for the Airbnb Growth SEO team. Built the frontend platform powering all of Airbnbs organic traffic landing pages.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
–	Led a cross-team squad of seven engineers working on migrating a large SPA web app from AngularJS to Angular and to modernize our codebase with latest tools such as webpack.
–	Front-end tech lead responsible for design and code reviews for Power BI SaaS client codebase.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
–	Worked on a small team dedicated to optimizing the performance of a large TypeScript codebase (400K+ lines of code), resulting in 70% faster initial load. Presented findings in Microsoft Web App Performance Symposium.
–	Led a small team to develop end-to-end infrastructure for collaboration features – shipped Dashboard & Report Commenting feature which contributed to increases in user engagement.
–	Led a small team to ship highly requested Dashboard Theming and User Persisted Filters features. Contributed to increase in consumer Net Promotor Score (customer satisfaction).


Publicly announced features I've helped deliver:
Dashboard & Report Commenting
https://powerbi.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/announcing-report-commenting-for-power-bi-service-and-mobile/

Persistent Filters in the Power BI service:
https://powerbi.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/announcing-persistent-filters-in-the-service

Conditional Formatting in Tables:
https://powerbi.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/power-bi-desktop-may-update-feature-summary/ 

Mobile Report Layout in Power BI Desktop
https://powerbi.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/power-bi-desktop-september-feature-summary/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
–	Developed back-end file upload flows for Power BI Desktop and Excel files into the Power BI service. Required close collaboration with the partner back-end infrastructure team and had 99% reliability after release. 
–	Contributed to core front-end UI features for the new canvas and visuals experience such as drag and drop visual creation, mobile layout creation, conditional formatting in tables, etc.

positions.title: Computer Vision Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched and published a paper on video face recognition in movie trailers. See publications section for details.

honors.title: Video Facial Recognition Research Licensed to Kairos
honors.description:
Research in video facial recognition developed by Enrique Ortiz, Dr. Mubarak Shah, and myself has been licensed to human analytics company Kairos. Read below for more details and see my "Publications" section for the relevant research. 

"An innovative, more precise and faster facial recognition technology—compared to the current state of the art—developed through the UCF Center for Research in Computer Vision has been licensed to human analytics company Kairos."

http://today.ucf.edu/human-analytics-company-licenses-innovative-ucf-developed-facial-recognition-technology/

publications.title: Face Recognition in Movie Trailers via Mean Sequence Sparse Representation-based Classification
publications.publisher: IEEE Conf. on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) · Jan 1, 2013

patents.title: Video Face Recognition
patents.description: This invention relates to face recognition. More specifically, it relates to identifying a video face track using a large dictionary of still face images of a few hundred people, while rejecting unknown individuals.

patents.title: Inviting co-travelers to view a reservation
